story.title: Every Cup Has an Aim: Uncompromising Mastery
story.p1: At Aim Coffee Bar, coffee is not an ordinary routine—it is a moment of clarity, renewal, and craft. Rooted in Northern Riyadh, we were born with a singular focus: delivering specialty coffee that never cuts corners.
story.p2: We partner with leading Saudi and international micro-roasteries, tuning water mineral composition, grind micron distributions, and extraction curves to ensure consistent elegance in every single sip.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Aim Coffee Bar, branches, and services
faq.a1: We welcome you daily from 6:00 AM until Midnight, with extended hours until 1:00 AM on Thursday and Friday nights.
faq.q2: Do you offer plant-based milk alternatives?
faq.a2: Yes, we offer organic oat milk and coconut milk as delicious dairy alternatives for all espresso and matcha beverages.
faq.q3: Is the café laptop-friendly for study or remote work?
faq.a3: Absolutely! Our spaces feature high-speed fiber Wi-Fi, accessible power outlets at seating tables, and calm daylight illumination.
faq.q4: How does curbside car pickup work?
faq.a4: Order ahead online, select Curbside Pickup with your vehicle details. Once you arrive outside, tap 'I Have Arrived' and our barista brings your order to your car window.
faq.q5: Can I purchase whole coffee beans for home brewing?
faq.a5: Yes, we offer freshly roasted 250g bags of specialty origins (Ethiopia, Colombia, El Salvador) whole bean or custom ground.
